property_summary: For every caller address, calling owned() must only succeed when msg.sender == owner (i.e., only the owner can call owned()); the mutant inverts the check so some non-owner callers can call owned(), breaking this rule for some fuzzed caller addresses.
change_summary: Invert the ownership check so that only non-owners can execute guarded functions, allowing someone other than owner to call owned() and thereby change observable owner-related behavior if owned() modifies state.
